grammar.label: raising verbs — seem, appear, prove, turn out, happen
grammar.meaning: the subject belongs to the second verb, not the first

explanation.en: In 'The method seems to work', the method does not seem anything — it works, and that is what seems true. The subject is 'raised' from the inner clause, which is why 'It seems that the method works' says the same thing.
explanation.uz: 'The method seems to work' — usul bir narsa 'ko'rinmaydi'; u ishlaydi, va shu narsa ko'rinadi. Ega ichki gapdan 'ko'tarilgan', shuning uchun 'It seems that the method works' ham xuddi shu ma'noni beradi.

grammar.positive_example: The earlier figures turned out to be wrong.
grammar.negative_example: The earlier figures turned out that they were wrong.

l1_notes.uz: Bu tuzilmada ega bosh fe'lning haqiqiy egasi emas — shuning uchun tarjimada 'that' ergash gapi bilan almashtirish osonroq.

grammar.label: control verbs — persuade, remind, enable, allow somebody to do
grammar.meaning: the object really is the doer of the second verb

explanation.en: In 'They persuaded him to sign', he signs — the object controls the infinitive. Compare the raising pattern: in 'They believed him to be honest', nobody does anything. Control verbs cannot be turned into 'It … that' sentences: 'It persuaded that he signed' is not English.
explanation.uz: 'They persuaded him to sign' — imzo chekuvchi 'him'. Bu tuzilmani 'It … that' shakliga aylantirib bo'lmaydi.

grammar.positive_example: The grant enabled the school to stay open.
grammar.negative_example: The grant enabled that the school stayed open.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilida ergash gap keng qo'llanadi, shuning uchun 'to'-li qurilma o'rniga 'that' ishlatish tez-tez uchraydi.

body.text: Then write both. 'The change appears to have reduced late arrivals.' Not 'has reduced'.

body.text: Why does it matter? Everyone can see it.

body.text: Because if it turns out to be the weather, we will have taught ourselves a fallacy.

body.text: He is right. Two things moving together do not make one of them the cause.

body.text: No. It is defensible and it is not proved. Those are different words.

body.text: And what persuaded the drivers to start earlier?
